stem.text: A vibrating bar produces surface water waves in a ripple tank.
The wavelength of the waves is $5.0\,\text{cm}$ and they pass through a gap of width $20\,\text{cm}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a ripple tank containing shallow water. A vibrating bar on the left produces straight wavefronts travelling right towards a barrier with a gap. Printed labels: vibrating bar, 5.0 cm, 20 cm, barrier with gap, ripple tank, shallow water.

stem.text: Which change will increase the amount of diffraction that is observed?

A.text: decreasing the distance between the bar and the gap

B.text: decreasing the frequency of the wave

C.text: increasing the amplitude of the wave

D.text: increasing the width of the gap
